verified: A voice request without a dashboard session creates a RAM proposal, with no SQLite definition or HA request.
A routines:manage cookie session lists, previews and confirms a creation, rejects another proposal, and previews and confirms an UPDATE proposal against its expected revision.
GET /api/routines includes disabled definitions and the voice catalog marks them as (desactivada). A voice state query reads the same catalog.
An approved selected routine executes by voice as household and by HTTP as the home credential's routine_actor, with observed actions and durable receipts.

A second home credential with the same subject cannot read the first credential's run or attempt. The home role is denied all routine definition and proposal management routes and cannot execute a disabled routine.

The voice brake records latest_voice_brake independently of the execution receipt, prevents the next HA send and interrupts the active run. In the stop variant the manager then disables the idle definition through HTTP.
Rebuilding the application on the same SQLite reopens the same definitions and receipts and empties the RAM proposal tray. The lifecycle writes no HA automations.
